translation: Took place in posad Serock, 18 February 1890, 9 AM. Appeared personally Jankel Borensztejn, szkolnik, 40, and Lewek Kendzior[?], shoemaker, 50, both residing in posad Serock, and declared that yesterday at 10 AM in posad Serock died a male child named Chil Welwel[?] Cykor[?], son of Chaim Jankel and of the mother Dwojra née Antoszewicz; two weeks of age. Upon eyewitness certification of the child's death this act was read to the witnesses and signed by us and one witness.
